text: Pause delivery: t3 thread send only queues for a busy agent; accept, or a steer path?

events.text: a) Accept queued delivery now. Also check, without an LLM, whether the board can reach the same steer the MCP tool uses (T3's server API behind t3_thread_send mode auto) from code; if it can with no new credential, use it, and log it. The request to T3 for a --steer flag is outward: I'm asking the user; make none yourself.
events.reason: Cheap and reversible, keeps the LLM out as the user ruled; busy agents are still named by the escalation; the outward ask goes to the user.
